sql: WITH ours AS (SELECT ndc11, package_ndc, lower(generic_name) AS molecule, spl_set_id FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product WHERE ndc11 IN ('51407070202', '55150024101', '67457021202', '00904705699', '49884000702', '71335153501', '55150021710', '00517100125', '00409163010', '60219174903', '16729030610', '00143960601', '71205067403', '50111078751', '50090749400', '71335249700', '00409397703', '55111065237')), plants AS (SELECT o.molecule, st.fei, st.firm_name FROM ours o JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = o.spl_set_id JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns) SELECT 'shortage' AS kind, o.molecule, sc.company_name AS firm, sc.status AS detail, sc.initial_posting_date AS dt FROM ours o JOIN fda.shortage_current sc ON sc.package_ndc = o.package_ndc WHERE sc.status = 'Current' UNION ALL SELECT 'oai', p.molecule, p.firm_name, i.inspection_id, i.end_date FROM plants p JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection i ON i.fei = p.fei WHERE i.classification = 'OAI' AND i.end_date >= '2023-10-21' UNION ALL SELECT 'action', p.molecule, p.firm_name, ca.action_type, ca.action_date FROM plants p JOIN fda.compliance_actions ca ON ca.fei = p.fei WHERE ca.action_date >= '2023-10-21' UNION ALL SELECT 'import_alert', p.molecule, p.firm_name, ia.alert, ia.date_published FROM plants p JOIN fda.import_alerts ia ON ia.fei = p.fei WHERE ia.date_published >= '2023-10-21'
